FAQs

Here are some common questions about quranbook.org and our mission to make the Holy Quran accessible to all Muslims.

quranbook.org is dedicated to making the Holy Quran accessible to Muslims through various educational formats and resources, enhancing learning and understanding.

We publish the Holy Quran in both digital and physical formats, offer educational programmes, and provide learning and recitation tools to ensure easy access for Muslims.

They believe in God and His Book and become Muslims in order to be saved from God’s painful punishment and enter the Paradise of the Lord of the Worlds..
